evidence.quote: rehearsals run monthly from now on

observations.why: Mandating a recurring rehearsal cadence appeals to security/stability (conservation) and to maintaining readiness as a craft (competence).

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic equivalence equates unrehearsed with nonexistent, appealing to genuine capability (competence) and to security that is real, not nominal (conservation).
Restating the cadence as a labeled property reinforces the recurring-readiness value: stability kept through repetition (conservation) and practiced mastery (competence).
Claiming ownership of the rehearsal program signals personal accountability for readiness — achievement/standing (self-enhancement) tied to mastery of the craft (competence).

mints.name: UnrehearsedEquivalence
mints.title: unrehearsed is nonexistent
mints.frame: Does the expression equate lack of practice with lack of the capability itself, collapsing the gap between nominal and real readiness?
